task.description:
WF-03 Step 05 + Final: Run tests and merge.

Pre-flight: backend :8080, Keycloak :8081. STOP BLOCKER if DOWN.

Tests:
1. cd web && npm run test (Vitest — includes buildRedirectArgs.test.ts, tenantConfig.test.ts)
2. cd web && npm run build

If all pass: then git-merge:
  git fetch origin main
  git rebase origin/main
  git push origin feature/WF03-oidc-callback-realm-20260616
  gh pr create --base main --title 'fix(WF03): embed realm in OIDC redirect_uri to fix callback loop (ISS-0073)' --body 'Root cause: signinRedirect() used a hard-coded redirect_uri without the realm param. Keycloak does not forward custom query params through the auth code flow, so the callback handler could not determine which realm to use for the token exchange, causing a redirect loop.\n\nFix: buildRedirectArgs() reads resolveRealmFromUrl() and appends ?realm=<slug> to the redirect_uri before the OIDC flow starts. The realm survives through Keycloak and is available at callback time.\n\n3/3 unit tests pass.'
  gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch
  git checkout main
  git pull --ff-only origin main

Write test report to tests/reports/report-2026-06-16-WF03-oidc-callback-realm-20260616-step-05.yaml

Return: test verdict, PR number, merge SHA.
